message: Type Owner is not defined. x-fern-type 'optional<map<string, list<Owner>>>' references it, but it is neither a Fern primitive nor a key of components.schemas, so Fern treats it as unknown.
x-fern-type 'map<Key, Owner>' uses 'Key' as a map key, but map keys must be primitive types; Fern ignores this type and falls back to the schema's own type.
